```java
private static void ackIntervals(Frame f, AckLog log, Journal j) {
    long low = f.v1 - f.v3;
    log.add(low, f.v1 + 1, j);
    for (int i = 0; i < f.pairs.length; i += 2) {
        long gap = f.pairs[i], range = f.pairs[i+1];
        long high = low - gap - 2;
        low = high - range;
        log.add(low, high + 1, j);
    }
}
```
